mapper.sql: id, product_code, product_name, study_mode, product_price, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into sale_product (product_code, product_name, study_mode, product_price, created_at, updated_at) values (#{productCode}, #{productName}, #{studyMode}, #{productPrice}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update sale_product set product_code = #{productCode}, product_name = #{productName}, study_mode = #{studyMode}, product_price = #{productPrice}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from sale_product where product_code = #{productCode} limit 1

select from sale_product
and ( product_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or product_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by id desc
